title: coleus klossii
intro: Coleus klossii, commonly known as the Kloss's Coleus, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. Coleus klossii is reported to possess health benefits such as reducing inflammation and relieving pain, as well as exhibiting therapeutic actions like antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Coleus klossii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
